acip: DE DAG GIS DON DAM PA BYANG CHUB GYI SEMS KYI DKYIL 'KHOR DU DBANG BZHI PA TSIG DBANG RIN PO CHE THOB, LUS NGAG YID GSUM GYI SGRIB PA'I BAG CHAGS 'KHRUD PA'I NUS PA BZHAG ,
wylie: de dag gis don dam pa byang chub gyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob, lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa'i bag chags 'khrud pa'i nus pa bzhag
english: With this, you have been granted the precious empowerment of the Fourth Initiation, within the secret world of the ultimate form of the Wish for enlightenment.
